purpose: Require small scoped reconstructible receipts at each material federated transition instead of relying on one generic receipt to imply an entire chain.

objective -> authority -> repo/path decision
referenced commit/ref resolves at source
run_id + event + head_sha + conclusion

negative fixture + expected failure + observed failure

algorithm + key identity class + signed bytes identity + verification result
old state + decision + canonical registry state + supersession pointer

both identities + normalization policy + comparable digest or explicit TOKEN_VAZIO

anti_patterns: one receipt implies an entire route
syntactically plausible SHA implies existing commit
Drive semantic mirror implies byte identity
test file exists implies test discovered/executed
